title: UniversalDeliveryPackManifest
description: Universal Delivery Pack Specification v1.0 Manifest Protocol Envelope.

specVersion.description: Semantic specification version of the Delivery Pack protocol standard.

packId.description: Unique Delivery Pack identifier chosen by the generator: letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' only (e.g. DP-2026-001, or <generator>-<project id>-v<pack version>).

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of pack generation.

name.description: Name of generating platform or CLI.

version.description: Version of generating platform or CLI.

url.description: Website or documentation URL of generator.

conformanceLevel.description: Standard conformance profile declared by this Delivery Pack.

hash.description: Lowercase-hex digest (64 characters for sha256, 128 for sha512) of the defined integrity file list; see SPECIFICATION.md section 3.1 for the exact bytes.

capabilities.description: Execution capabilities required or supported (e.g., worktree-isolation, multi-agent-review, docker-sandbox).

policies.description: Governance or agent policies enforced by this pack.

tasks.description: Ordered array of task IDs included in the delivery pack.

artifacts.description: List of core architecture and decision artifacts produced.

items.description: File path relative to the section folder; no '..', no leading '/', no drive letter, no backslash.
